title: Ranch Property Film Estimate

deliverables.title: Ranch Property Film (Lean Production)
deliverables.description: A story-driven ranch film shot by one operator over two days, with no crew to fly in. Your current films lead with landscape and history. I'd anchor the story in a person: the owner or steward on camera explaining what this land has meant and why it matters, with aerials and an animated boundary map carrying the scale.

lineItems.details: Sunrise-to-sunset coverage over two days to catch golden hour on both ends and work around weather. Landscape, ranch operations, structures and water, plus a sit-down owner or steward interview. Includes pre-production planning and a shot list.
Story development and edit of a 3-4 minute film built around the interview, with color grading and sound design.
Aerial coverage of the full property: terrain, boundaries, water, structures and access.
Includes an extra hour for setup and teardown and the following lights: Aputure Nova, Aputure MC (x4), Amaran T4C, Amaran F22x + dBtx lavalier microphone packs.
Satellite map animation showing property boundaries, acreage and key features.
Simple intro/outro title slides with the property name and your logo, and a lower thirds graphic with the interviewee's name.
Find, license and add royalty free background music that fits the property. Cleared for all uses.
Two rounds of revisions on the edit.
Full transfer on delivery. Use it on listings, web, social, broadcast and paid ads with no ongoing licensing fees.
